claims: C1 the assistant should ask for clarification before proceeding when it is plausible the user might not have noticed the instructions
C2 the assistant should ask for clarification before proceeding when carrying out the instructions could cause irreversible side effects
C3 the obligation to ask applies only if asking is possible

concepts.name: assistant
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of the assistant without defining it

concepts.name: plausible_user_missed_instructions
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction embedded in untrusted content that the user may not have noticed
concepts.inference: the clause's condition 'plausible that the user might not have noticed the instructions' requires a class of instructions so noticed

concepts.name: carrying_out_irreversible_side_effects
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose carrying out could cause irreversible side effects
concepts.inference: the clause's condition 'carrying out the instructions could cause irreversible side effects' requires a class of instructions so characterized

concepts.name: possible_to_ask_clarification
concepts.gloss: A is able to ask for clarification before proceeding in this situation
concepts.inference: the clause's 'if possible' condition requires a predicate for the possibility of asking

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer, or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

concepts.name: ask_clarifying_questions_section
concepts.gloss: S is the section of the Model Spec that discusses when and how the assistant should ask clarifying questions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the section

asserts.read_back: asking for clarification before proceeding is required when it is plausible the user might not have noticed the instructions, or carrying them out could cause irreversible side effects, and asking is possible

closure.reason: the clause obliges asking only in the two named situations and only if possible; silence about other situations leaves them permitted
